Subject: Marketplace listing governance — support SLA matrix & trademark check

Hi team,

Attaching the initial support SLA matrix and a short checklist we run for marketplace listings. We want to make sure we hit Procurements' evidence requirements before we submit the listing to AWS Marketplace (and mirrored for Azure/GCP). Please review the items below and confirm answers where you can: 

- Support window required by listing tier (standard vs production) — we typically offer 9x5 for standard, 24x7 for production.
- Escalation path (L1/L2/L3) + on-call contact for critical incidents.
- Branding/claim language: any trademarked terms or third-party marks - need clearance before listing copy goes live.
- Evidence: SOC 2 type II summary, uptime SLA language, error-rate reporting cadence.

Attachments: support_sla_matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Ask: Could you confirm the support window and any regional coverage constraints for ProspectCorp? Procurement will also want an evidence list for the marketplace intake.

Thanks — I can loop in our Security team if they want a SOC excerpt.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Marketplace listing governance — support SLA matrix & trademark check

Rishi —

Thanks for the checklist and spreadsheet. A few clarifying items from our side: 

- For our production tenants we require 24x7 support (phone + email) with a guaranteed critical response time of 1 hour. Standard customers can be 9x5 email first response within 4 hours.
- Procurement will need SOC 2 Type II evidence (or an executive summary) and a named escalation contact with a reachable phone number.
- On branding/claims: we cannot publish any claims that imply co-sell endorsement from AWS/Azure/GCP. If you reference partner badges, please confirm you have rights to use the logos and provide brand guidelines.

Can you send the SOC summary and a proposed escalation matrix? If you have a support runbook or playbook, that would accelerate our internal review.

Regards,
Maya Singh
Cloud Operations Manager, ProspectCorp
cloudops@prospectcorp.com

Hi Maya —

Thanks for the clear asks. Quick answers below and attaching the items you requested.

- Support windows: We can commit to 24x7 phone + email for the Production tier (customers with dedicated capacity). Standard (self-serve) remains 9x5 email. We'll map the listing to the Production support tier for ProspectCorp's integrated offering.
- Escalation: see attached "support-runbook.pdf" (high-level: L1 triage -> L2 engineering -> L3 on-call; critical incidents route to on-call pager with 1-hour SLT response). Named contacts are provided in the runbook.
- SOC 2: attaching "SOC2-summary.pdf" (executive summary + control highlights). Full report is available under NDA; if Procurement needs it we can start the process.
- Branding/claims: we do not use any AWS/Azure/GCP co-sell badges unless we are an approved marketplace listing and have the partner marketing agreement in place. For ProspectCorp's listing copy, we recommend: 
  - avoid wording like "AWS endorsed" or "official co-sell"
  - use neutral phrasing: "Available on AWS Marketplace" (once approved)

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf (summary), support-runbook.pdf (playbook)

Next steps: If Procurement confirms they want the full SOC report under NDA and the specific regions (US/EU/APAC) for coverage, I'll prepare a condensed evidence packet for their intake form.

Best regards,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Operations, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
